fullTextEN: Hello everyone, I am Teacher Bella.
I am from Taiwan.
I am a Chinese teacher.

fullTextZH: 可是在当中文老师以前，
fullTextEN: But before becoming a Chinese teacher,

fullTextZH: 我做过很多不一样的工作。
fullTextEN: I have done many different jobs.
I have worked in a café,
I have also worked in a restaurant,
and also in a hotel.
But today,

fullTextZH: Bella老师要告诉你一个特别的故事。
fullTextEN: Teacher Bella wants to tell you a special story.
Besides those jobs just mentioned,

fullTextZH: 我还做过一个非常奇怪的工作。
fullTextEN: I have also done a very strange job.

fullTextZH: 那我先不告诉你这个工作是什么，
fullTextEN: I won't tell you what this job is yet,
because I want you to guess.

fullTextZH: 那我们就一起来听一下这个故事吧！
fullTextEN: So let's listen to this story together!
It was more than ten years ago,
At that time, I graduated from university,
I didn't want to work in Taiwan,

fullTextZH: 所以我一个人到了澳大利亚工作。
fullTextEN: so I went to work in Australia alone.
At that time,

fullTextZH: 澳大利亚给台湾的年轻人，
fullTextEN: Australia gives a special visa to young people from Taiwan,
a special visa.
This visa,

fullTextZH: 可以让你在澳大利亚工作一年，
fullTextEN: allows you to work in Australia for a year,
then travel while having fun.
So, many Taiwanese people,

fullTextZH: 那个时候都到澳大利亚去工作。
fullTextEN: at that time all went to Australia to work.
Some people,
went to farms to pick strawberries.
When I first arrived in Australia,
my English wasn't good,

fullTextZH: 所以我不知道我应该找什么样的工作。
fullTextEN: so I didn't know what kind of job I should look for.
But at that time,
many people went to work on farms,
because Australia is very big,

fullTextZH: 可是呢，没有很多人到农场工作。
fullTextEN: but not many people went to work on farms.

fullTextZH: 而且啊，如果你到农场工作，
fullTextEN: Moreover, if you work on a farm,
you can stay in Australia for two years.

fullTextZH: 所以那个时候我觉得，嗯，
fullTextEN: So at that time I thought, hmm,

fullTextZH: 可能我可以到农场工作。
fullTextEN: maybe I can work on a farm.
So I went online to look for a job,
I wrote these words:
Hello everyone, I am Bella,
I am from Taiwan,
I work very hard,
So if you have a job,
You can call me.

fullTextZH: 就这样，第二天我接到了一个电话。
fullTextEN: Just like that, the next day I received a call.

fullTextZH: 电话是一个老男人打给我的。
fullTextEN: The call was from an old man.
I couldn't understand what he was saying,
I couldn't understand.

fullTextZH: 可是我听到他说：我有一个工作，
fullTextEN: But I heard him say: I have a job,
I can give you this job.

fullTextZH: 所以那个时候我很开心，
fullTextEN: So at that time I was very happy,
I told him:

fullTextZH: 没问题，我想去你的农场工作。
fullTextEN: No problem, I want to work on your farm.
So I asked him:
Where is your farm?
I looked online,

fullTextZH: 天呐，这个农场需要坐巴士，
fullTextEN: Oh my, this farm requires taking a bus,
8 hours!

fullTextZH: 可是那个时候我没有想太多，
fullTextEN: But at that time, I didn't think too much,
because I wanted this job.

fullTextZH: 所以第二天我就订了巴士票，
fullTextEN: So the next day, I booked a bus ticket,
took an 8-hour bus ride,
and arrived at this place.
The boss told me:
When you arrive at the bus station,
just wait for me there.
So after I arrived,
I took a look,

fullTextZH: 我看到了一台白色的车，
fullTextEN: I saw a white car,
This car was both broken and old.

fullTextZH: 然后啊，一个胖胖的老男人下了车，
fullTextEN: Then, a chubby old man got out of the car,
He slowly walked towards me.
At that moment, I thought,

fullTextZH: 这个老男人是不是我的老板啊？
fullTextEN: Is this old man my boss?
That's right, he was my boss.
So I got in the car,

fullTextZH: 我们开车开了大概5分钟，
fullTextEN: We drove for about 5 minutes,
Finally arrived at the farm.
But I took a look,
This farm,
No cows, no sheep,
Also no chickens,
Also no vegetables.
Just an old house.
Is this really a farm?

fullTextZH: 所以啊，我走进去里面看，
fullTextEN: So, I went inside to look,
Then I saw inside the house,

fullTextZH: 有一颗一颗圆圆的东西。
fullTextEN: There were round things.

fullTextZH: 然后我还看到房子的外面停了两艘船。
fullTextEN: Then I also saw two boats parked outside the house.
Speaking of this,

fullTextZH: 你知道我在哪里工作吗？
fullTextEN: Do you know where I work?
That's right, it's an oyster farm!
What is an oyster?
This is an oyster.
In Australia,
Oysters are very, very expensive,

fullTextZH: 所以这一颗一颗的生蚝都是钱。
fullTextEN: So each oyster is money.

fullTextZH: 那我在生蚝农场做什么工作呢？
fullTextEN: So what do I do at the oyster farm?
We need to,
Take these oysters one by one,

fullTextZH: 分大的生蚝和小的生蚝，
fullTextEN: Separate the big oysters from the small ones,

fullTextZH: 然后再把它们放进袋子里。
fullTextEN: Then put them into bags.

fullTextZH: 这个时候老板会开船带我们去海上，
fullTextEN: At this time, the boss will take us out to sea by boat,

fullTextZH: 然后你会看到这样子的地方。
fullTextEN: Then you will see a place like this.

fullTextZH: 我们需要把这些生蚝的袋子，
fullTextEN: We need to hang these oyster bags,
One by one.
This is our job.

fullTextZH: 所以啊，在我们工作的时候，
fullTextEN: So, when we work,

fullTextZH: 我们需要穿这种特别的衣服。
fullTextEN: We need to wear this kind of special clothing.
In the summer,
It's fun, but think about it,
In the winter when it's very cold,
We need to put our hands,
Into the icy water.

fullTextZH: 每次我都因为太冷非常想哭。
fullTextEN: Every time, because it's so cold, I really want to cry.
However,

fullTextZH: 在生蚝农场工作也有特别的回忆。
fullTextEN: Working at the oyster farm also has special memories.
For example, I remember one time,

fullTextZH: 我就看到在我们的船旁边，
fullTextEN: I saw next to our boat,

fullTextZH: 有一只一只的海豚跟着我们的船，
fullTextEN: there were dolphins following our boat,
and jumping beside us.
When I saw it,

fullTextZH: 我都觉得这真的像电影一样。
fullTextEN: I felt it was just like a movie.
Alright,

fullTextZH: 这就是我做过最有意思、最特别的工作。
fullTextEN: this is the most interesting and special job I've done.

fullTextZH: 虽然那个时候英文啊说得不好，
fullTextEN: Although my English wasn't good at that time,
the work was also very hard,

fullTextZH: 但是啊，我也从这个工作学习了很多。
fullTextEN: but I learned a lot from this job.
Every time I think of this job,
I find it very interesting.

fullTextZH: 你们呢，你们有没有做过什么特别
fullTextEN: How about you, have you done anything special
and interesting for work?

fullTextZH: 欢迎你在下面留言告诉我哦！
fullTextEN: Feel free to leave a comment below and let me know!
I am Teacher Bella,
see you in the next video.
Bye bye!
